items.title: Norman Mason Interview, 1960-02-06
items.q: The interviewee mentions 'Wang Wang' in the context of describing a tune ('The Wang Wang blues') and scat singing associated with Louis Armstrong, but does not state a personal relationship with Wang Wang himself.

ctx.x: Da-da. Da-da. Wang Wang. Wang Wang. The Wang Wang blues. That's what he used to play on it. See, the Wang Wang blues. And, uh... That scat... That scat singing that he did. We had a piece once that, uh... Called, uh... Don't Take Away Those Blues. And they had a whole lot of... It was quite a bit of words to that piece. You know, he'd say... Don't take away those blues. That's the way it, uh... Really... The tune went. Anyway, Louis, uh... The captain used to insist on somebody singing. And, of course, Louis…
